quote: What is better—to be born good, or to overcome your evil nature through great effort?
author: Paarthurnax

quote: To defeat your enemy, first eliminate their allies.
author: Karliah

quote: A sure sign of a fool is dismissing as impossible anything not confirmed by their own experience.
author: Farengar Secret-Fire

quote: Make use of every opportunity life gives you, because you never know when your time to leave will come.
author: Gharaz

quote: Just because the world is the way it is doesn't mean it has to stay that way forever.
author: Jorleif Gray-Mane

quote: You know who really makes history? The person who writes it down.
author: Jorrn

quote: Face hardship without fear! Leave gossip and servility to gutter rats who can't stand up for themselves.
author: Kodlak Whitemane

quote: Seek the truth. Uphold the law. When in doubt, seek the counsel of the wise.
author: Julianos

quote: Let me guess... Someone stole your sweetroll?
author: Guard

quote: The time and place of every great deed are determined by Fate. But without a Hero, there can be no great deed.
author: Zurin Arctus

quote: There is both light and darkness within us. What matters is which side we choose.
author: Sirius Black

quote: It takes courage to stand up to your enemies, but even greater courage to stand up to your friends.
author: Albus Dumbledore

quote: Happiness can be found even in the darkest of times, if one only remembers to turn on the light.
author: Albus Dumbledore

quote: You fail to understand that it matters not what someone is born, but what they grow to be!
author: Albus Dumbledore

quote: Those who love us never really leave us.
author: Sirius Black

quote: So, you fear fear itself most of all. That is admirable!
author: Remus Lupin

quote: It is easier to forgive people for being wrong than for being right.
author: Albus Dumbledore

quote: After all, to the well-organized mind, death is but the next great adventure.
author: Albus Dumbledore

quote: Everything we lose eventually comes back to us, though not always in the way we expect.
author: Luna Lovegood

quote: Fear of a name increases fear of the thing itself.
author: Hermione Granger

quote: Even the smallest person can change the course of the future.
author: Galadriel

quote: A wizard is never late, nor is he early. He arrives precisely when he means to.
author: Gandalf

quote: For nothing is evil in the beginning.
author: Elrond

quote: Any riddle, once solved, seems remarkably easy.
author: Gandalf

quote: 'If only I! If only you!' he said. 'Idle talk begins with “if.”'
author: Denethor

quote: Many that live deserve death. And some that die deserve life.
author: Gandalf

quote: You want a name? What good is a name? Tell me, who will you be if you are stripped of your names?
author: Tom Bombadil

quote: Evil can be spoken of in many ways. Some sow evil themselves; others—true friends—wander in distant lands in times of peace and prosperity, only to appear on a dark day and lend a helping hand.
author: Gandalf

quote: Of all the evils and hardships Fate has in store, none is so bitter and shameful for a man as to win the love of a fair and fearless maiden and be unable to return it.
author: Aragorn

quote: It's not the stories that come to an end. The heroes simply come and go when their work is done.
author: Frodo Baggins

quote: Do. Or do not. There is no try.
author: Yoda

quote: May the Force be with you.
author: Unknown

quote: I find your lack of faith disturbing.
author: Darth Vader

quote: Many of the truths we cling to depend on our point of view.
author: Obi-Wan Kenobi

quote: Who's more foolish: the fool, or the fool who follows him?
author: Obi-Wan Kenobi

quote: Fear leads to the dark side.
author: Yoda

quote: I'm just a person trying to find my way in the universe.
author: Jango Fett

quote: So this is how liberty dies—with thunderous applause.
author: Padmé Amidala

quote: The higher you raise your nose, the harder you'll fall.
author: Count Dooku

quote: Death is a natural part of life. Rejoice for those around you who transform into the Force. Mourn them not; miss them not. Attachment leads to jealousy, and jealousy is the shadow of greed.
author: Yoda

quote: Coincidence is just the universe's way of remaining anonymous.
author: Master Oogway

quote: Don't take every little nut and bolt so much to heart... It might not take it. This is no joke; it's your health we're talking about.
author: Sovunya

quote: Here's the paradox: we perform heroic deeds for those who no longer care about us, while those who love us need no heroics from us.
author: Losyash

quote: You can't force someone to change, even if they ask you to. Once you're ready, you can change on your own, without anyone else's help.
author: Krosh

quote: A true friend won't abandon you. And if they're not a true friend, there's nothing to worry about.
author: Krosh

quote: Why should I pretend I'm happy when I'm actually feeling miserable?
author: Barash

quote: What's the point of a universe without miracles?
author: Barash

quote: No, seriously! There are problems whose scale no one but you seems to notice. No one! Everyone lives in their own little worlds, in shells built in their own image. But there are questions of planetary scale! Of universal scale! How can we get these questions through the walls of their shells?
author: Kar-Karych

quote: No matter what anyone says, we're all special and unique. And it's wonderful that, despite our differences, we can understand one another. So why, when we suddenly understand this world much better than others do, does misunderstanding arise?
author: Pin

quote: It's very hard to live while thinking about every mistake you've made, so you forget the bad and remember only the good. It's convenient, but you can't escape yourself.
author: Kar-Karych

quote: Do you ever have thoughts in your head that are beautiful, striking, and perfectly aimed, but when you say them aloud, they come out as complete nonsense?
author: Barash

quote: People board express trains, yet they don't understand what they're looking for. So they find no peace, rushing first one way, then another... all in vain. The eyes are blind. One must look with the heart.
author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry

quote: This is what my fox was like before. He was no different from a hundred thousand other foxes. But I made him my friend, and now he is unique in all the world.
author: The Little Prince

quote: Your rose is special. It is your rose. The time you spent on her is what makes her so important.
author: The Fox

quote: Worthless people live only to eat and drink. Worthy people eat and drink only to live.
author: Socrates

quote: People seldom think of darkness in the light, of misfortune in happiness, or of suffering in comfort. Yet in darkness they think of light, in misfortune of happiness, and in poverty of prosperity.
author: Immanuel Kant

quote: A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
author: Laozi

quote: From the past, we learn about the future; from what is clear, we understand what is hidden.
author: Mozi

quote: Whatever we set out to do, the time always seems wrong, and circumstances are never perfectly favorable. Those who wait for the ideal moment may never begin—and if they do, they often meet with failure.
author: Niccolò Machiavelli

quote: To live is not merely to breathe; it is to act. The person who has lived the most is not the one who has counted the most years, but the one who has felt life most deeply.
author: Jean-Jacques Rousseau

quote: You cannot teach a person to be happy, but you can raise them in such a way that they will be happy.
author: Alexander Pushkin

quote: I think only unsuccessful, unhappy people enjoy arguing. Happy people live quietly.
author: Maxim Gorky

quote: An excessively comfortable life often spoils one's character, just as too much food upsets the stomach. In such cases, both body and soul may be cured by remedies that are unpleasant—even repulsive—to the taste.
author: Charles Dickens

quote: Success is not final; failure is not fatal: what counts is the courage to continue.
author: Winston Churchill
